audience.description: Writers, editors, and developers evaluating AI-assisted editorial workflows

intent: Announce the repository without unsupported adoption, maturity, or performance claims
subject: Human Writing Rules repository
central_question: What is available in the repository and what problem does it address?
reader_promise: Readers will understand the repository's stable specification scope and the limits of its reference tooling.
constraints: Do not invent users, adoption, metrics, or testimonials
Do not present roadmap work as shipped
Do not present reference tooling as a universally conforming production engine

sources.title: Human Writing Rules README
sources.scope: Project positioning, supported content, and current tooling

claims.text: Human Writing Rules is a vendor-neutral editorial specification for articles, social posts, and optional illustrations.
The repository contains modular rules, reviewers, schemas, examples, and a guarded reference workflow.
The specification is stable, but roadmap items are not shipped capabilities and bundled reference tooling does not claim complete implementation conformance.
The repository measurably improves writing quality for all users.
claims.qualification: No public benchmark evidence supports this universal claim.

media.reason: The benchmark isolates text behavior and does not require a visual.
